Experience the mountains

Reaching new heights in Niedersachsen

You are here
  • Home
  • Destinations
  • Experience the mountains

Niedersachsen’s mountain landscapes are waiting for you!  

Here you’ll find some of the most stunning holiday destinations and excursions for anyone with a head for heights. Whether in the Harz Mountains National Park, the Weser Uplands Nature Park or the UNESCO Global Geopark Terra.Vita near Osnabrück – discover towering peaks, dramatic cliffs, breathtaking views, and a wealth of cultural attractions and leisure activities.

Where culture and adventure meet nature

Excursions in the mountains 

Thomas Goebert, Solling-Vogler-Region im Weserbergland e. V. | CC-BY-ND

The mountains offer countless attractions and sights that will make your visit truly unforgettable. Discover unique UNESCO World Heritage Sites, immerse yourself in the fascinating world of mining, or feel the rush of a ride on a summer toboggan run. For history and culture enthusiasts, museums provide a stimulating insight into the region’s rich mining heritage. Step into the shoes of nobility with a visit to impressive castles and palaces or get the whole family fired up at lively open-air theatre performances. 

 

© Gregor Lengler, TMN!
